name: Erin Balfour
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As a therapist, I understand the need for warmth and acceptance. My training in Gestalt therapy, informed by trauma sensitivity and attachment theory guides me to prioritize safety and human experiences in relationship. With a strong practice underpinned by neuroscience and somatic trauma therapy approaches, I work towards creating greater tolerance toward uncomfortable sensations that arise out of difficult experiences.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Paula-Jane Buckland
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Paula-Jane (she/her) is a counsellor and psychotherapist from Melbourne who finds great privilege in supporting those during times they need. She prides herself on being able to place herself in the role that will best support the client and is passionate about assisting clients to live their best lives with themselves and others. Paula-Jane is an accredited mental health counsellor, relationship counsellor, psychotherapist and sex therapist.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Kirsty VandenBurg
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: We can all face difficulties like anxiety, stress and depression at one time or another and sometimes we need help to navigate these times. I specialise in working with adolescents and adults who have experienced grief and loss, PTSD, attachment/childhood trauma and intergenerational trauma. I am trained in and use Existential, Solution Focused, Schema, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Nicholas Pearce
